key.answer_key: The panel qualifies the claim rather than fully bearing it out. At zero charge the Fe edge sits only about 2/3 of the way toward the Fe3+ line, and the edge shift is just ~1.6 eV of the ~5.9 eV span that a full Fe2+ to Fe3+ change would require, so Fe's redox contribution is partial rather than complete. The V edge sits between V3+ and V5+, consistent with the V side of the claim.
